import { Box, Cylinder, type Geometry } from '@caemble/core'
export const Bracket: Geometry<{ thickness: number; holeRadius: number; holePosition: number }> = ({ thickness = 0.2, holeRadius = 0.1, holePosition = 0.55 }) =>
  <subtract><Box id="plate" size={[1,0.6,thickness]} position={[0.5,0,0]} /><Cylinder id="hole" radius={holeRadius} height={2 * thickness} position={[holePosition,0,0]} /></subtract>

async def simulate(*, sim, tasks, vars):
    result = await sim.run(tasks["detail"])
    for name in ("displacement", "reaction", "stress", "stressField"):
        await sim.record(name, result["artifacts"][name])
    sim.release(result["artifacts"])
    return result["state"]
